source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fallback builds text/plain with the available original charset and passes obj->encoding to the synthetic child. The opener creates Content-Type and Content-Transfer-Encoding headers; child allocation copies its headers and override type before temporary strings are freed. The length expression includes charset, punctuation and the terminator, as requested in review. The test covers one malformed text subtype with quoted-printable ISO-8859-1, not every missing-header or allocation-failure case. Required Bug comment 8 remains unavailable, so this source contribution has zero full-audit credit.
title: Untyped text fallback carries encoding and charset through synthetic child headers
